funds.name: Pershing Square
funds.summary: Bill Ackman's investment firm. It holds a concentrated set of large U.S.-listed companies.
funds.scope: These are the 13F reports of the Pershing Square group of managers, combined without double counting. They do not include private investments, shorts or non-U.S.-listed holdings.
funds.reporting: For Q2 2026, Pershing Square Inc. (CIK 2026053, formerly Pershing Square Holdco, L.P.) filed the 13F holdings report for the group. Pershing Square Capital Management, L.P. (CIK 1336528) filed a 13F notice that points to that report. For earlier quarters, Tokscale adds Pershing Square Capital Management's holdings report to Pershing Square Holdco's combination report. A combination report lists only the positions that no other report covers, so the two do not overlap.
